sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Tomb of the Cat Color are simple yet challenging. You control the cat using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, and your goal is to paint your way through the cemetery to reach the exit. The game features a unique painting mechanic, where you can paint walls, floors, and other objects to create a path to the exit. However, you must be strategic in your painting, as each brush stroke takes time and coins. The game also features obstacles, such as tombstones and fences, that you must navigate around or paint over to reach the exit.
         
         The game's core mechanics are built around the cat's ability to paint and collect coins. You must collect all the coins in each level to achieve victory, but you also need to paint your way through obstacles to reach the exit before time runs out. The game's time limit adds an extra layer of challenge, as you must balance between collecting coins and painting your way out of the level.
         
         As you progress through the game, the levels become increasingly difficult, with more obstacles and less time to complete each level. However, the game also features power-ups and bonuses that can help you overcome these challenges. For example, you can collect speed boosts, extra lives, or coins to help you complete a level.
